summary.sub: 三条都来自Google：芯片、机器人、基因组，均用官方博客加独立媒体核对。

items.t: Google发布TPU 8tx和TPU 8i Max，8tx与AMD合作设计，主打保密推理
DeepMind发布Gemini Robotics 2.5，测试覆盖200多项任务，通过机器人合作伙伴推出
DeepMind发布AlphaGenome 2，用超过1亿个细胞图谱训练，API开放给非商业研究

title.text: Google发布TPU 8tx和TPU 8i Max两款新芯片

oneline.text: 第八代TPU再添两个型号，一个做保密推理，一个把两颗8i合成一颗。

bullets.v: 11月9日Google公布TPU 8tx和TPU 8i Max，称一年内已推出四套新TPU系统。
8tx与AMD合作设计，面向安全和保密推理；8i Max的算力、SRAM和HBM带宽是8i的两倍。
两份来源都没给出上市或交付时间，性能数字来自Google自述。

sourceEvidence.quote: marking four new TPU systems in a single year
TPU 8tx, our third eighth-generation system, is optimized for secure and confidential inference
delivering double the compute, double the SRAM and double the HBM bandwidth of TPU 8i

sourceEvidence.claim: 两款新型号属于第八代
sourceEvidence.quote: The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips
TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, is based on the TPU 8t chip
TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April

oneline.text: 官方称这是它迄今最强的视觉-语言-动作模型，先给机器人合作伙伴用。

bullets.v: 11月10日DeepMind发布Gemini Robotics 2.5，测试覆盖200多项不同任务。
官方称成功率按任务类型提高30%到100%；Apollo 2人形机器人装汽车零件成功率96%。
目前通过机器人合作伙伴推出，官方没说是否广泛开放；96%只是单个场景的数字。

sourceEvidence.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
Gemini Robotics 2.5 achieves a 30% to 100% higher success rate depending on the type of task
Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate
The new robotics AI model was tested across over 200 distinct tasks
Gemini Robotics 2.5 is rolling out today via DeepMind’s robotics partners

title.text: DeepMind发布AlphaGenome 2，预测DNA变异怎么影响细胞

oneline.text: 用超过1亿个细胞图谱训练，API今天起开放给非商业研究。

bullets.v: 11月11日DeepMind发布AlphaGenome 2，训练数据覆盖68种组织、超过1亿个单细胞图谱。
官方称它找出的、会改变细胞基因表达的变异数量接近原来的两倍。
目前通过AlphaGenome API开放给非商业研究，未获批用于临床或诊断。

sourceEvidence.quote: AlphaGenome 2 identifies nearly twice as many variants that change gene expression in cells
Trained on more than 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues
AlphaGenome 2 is available today for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API
a next-generation AI model that can predict how DNA sequences and their variations affect human cell types
the model is not approved for clinical or diagnostic use
